**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 24 of the Copperleaf agreement sits at or above our preferred ASSIGN position:

- **§ 24.1** — we may assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (prompt notice only); **§ 13.3** extends the same carve-out to licence rights.
- **§ 24.2** — Vendor is the restricted party: our prior written consent (reasonableness-qualified) for assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control, plus a bar on assigning to a direct competitor.
- **§ 24.4** — no Vendor right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on our change of control, with a cooperation obligation for successor administration.
- **§ 24.3** — the residual consent gate applies only to "other assignments" outside the 24.1 carve-out, is mutual, and is not-unreasonably-withheld/conditioned/delayed, so it does not claw back our M&A rights.

No conflicting change-of-control trigger elsewhere; § 9.2's insolvency right expressly excludes a lawful reorganization that does not impair performance.
